title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
title_zh: 面向视频生成中动态主体集合的主体一致性

paragraphs.en: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over dynamic subject sets . We therefore introduce DynSC-Eval , an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，随着视频生成延伸到更长的时长，主体一致性应当在动态主体集合上进行评估。 因此，我们提出 DynSC-Eval，一个在整个可见生命周期内动态追踪符合条件的主体、并使用六个互补的对象级指标来衡量局部连续性与全局身份保持的评估框架，同时显式检测不一致事件。 为验证其有效性，我们设计了主动注入不一致事件的合成实验，证明了 DynSC-Eval 的敏感性以及现有指标的局限性。 对多种模型在 5 秒、15 秒和 60 秒视频生成上的评估进一步揭示了被常规指标所掩盖的显著主体一致性差异。 除评估之外，我们还基于 DynSC-Eval 构建奖励，并在自动驾驶测试平台中应用 DiffusionNFT 后训练。 在 5 秒生成上，我们的方法使 Wan-2.1-1.3B 的六个不一致指标平均降低 13.82%，使 SANA-2B 平均降低 5.66%，在 I2V 模型 ReSim 上也观察到了提升。 定性比较进一步证明了我们方法的有效性。 随后，我们通过课程学习将生成时长扩展到 10 秒和 30 秒，并表明一致性优化仍然有效，同时在很大程度上保留了其他能力。

paragraphs.en: Video models are increasingly moving towards long-video generation. Many commercial models now natively support generation of high-quality videos more than 10 seconds ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Wiedemer et al., 2025 ; Team, 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ; MiniMax, 2026 ) , while some streaming models can even achieve minute-level video generation ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Over longer temporal horizons, subjects may enter, leave, and interact, allowing both the composition of the visible subject set and the relationships among its members to evolve. Even within a continuous single shot, maintaining temporal consistency across these changing subjects remains challenging. Fig. 1 demonstrates failures in long-video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频模型正日益朝着长视频生成的方向发展。 许多商业模型现已原生支持生成超过 10 秒的高质量视频（OpenAI, 2025；Wiedemer et al., 2025；Team, 2025；Seedance et al., 2026；MiniMax, 2026），而一些流式模型甚至能够实现分钟级视频生成（Chen et al., 2025a；Yang et al., 2025c；Yuan et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2026）。 在更长的时间跨度上，主体可能进入、离开并发生交互，使得可见主体集合的构成以及其成员之间的关系都能随时间演变。 即使在连续的单个镜头内，在这些不断变化的主体之间保持时间一致性仍然具有挑战性。 图 1 展示了长视频生成中的失败案例。

sents.zh: 图 1 展示了长视频生成中的失败案例。

paragraphs.en: The frequency and severity of these failures can reveal differences in models’ capability. An ideal video generator should maintain each subject’s temporal consistency throughout its visible lifespan. Thus, evaluating subject consistency over dynamic subject sets is a more appropriate assessment way. Here, dynamic subject sets means both the membership and cardinality of the visible subject set can change over time. Evaluation of subject consistency should cover the union of dynamic subject sets throughout the video. However, existing consistency metrics primarily rely on holistic frame-level comparisons ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , sparsely sampled frames ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , or reference-based assessment of selected subjects ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These approaches either lack sensitivity in subject detection or overlook inconsistencies involving subjects that enter later in the video.
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败的频率与严重程度可以揭示模型能力之间的差异。 理想的视频生成器应当在其可见生命周期内保持每个主体（subject）的时间一致性。 因此，在动态主体集合上评估主体一致性是一种更合适的评估方式。 这里，动态主体集合指的是可见主体集合的成员和数量都可以随时间变化。 主体一致性的评估应覆盖整个视频中所有动态主体集合的并集。 然而，现有的一致性度量主要依赖于整体帧级比较（Huang 等，2023；Liu 等，2023b；Huang 等，2024；Liu 等，2026）、稀疏采样的帧（Sun 等，2024），或针对选定主体的基于参照的评估（Zhou 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026；Ying 等，2026；Li 等，2026）。 这些方法要么在主体检测上缺乏敏感性，要么忽略了视频中较晚出现的主体所涉及的不一致性。

sents.zh: 这些失败的频率与严重程度可以揭示模型能力之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we introduce DynSC-Eval , an evaluation framework that dynamically updates the subject set to track each eligible subject throughout its visible lifespan. It decomposes temporal consistency into local and global components, measured using six complementary metrics. Local consistency captures short-term temporal continuity and incorporates explicit detection and counting of inconsistency events, while global consistency measures long-term identity preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 DynSC-Eval，这是一个动态更新主体集合、在每个符合条件的主体的可见生命周期内对其进行追踪的评测框架。 它将时序一致性分解为局部和全局两个组成部分，并使用六项互补的指标进行度量。 局部一致性捕捉短期时序连续性，并包含对不一致事件的显式检测与计数，而全局一致性则衡量长期的主体身份保持能力。

sents.en: To address this gap, we introduce DynSC-Eval , an evaluation framework that dynamically updates the subject set to track each eligible subject throughout its visible lifespan.
sents.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 DynSC-Eval，这是一个动态更新主体集合、在每个符合条件的主体的可见生命周期内对其进行追踪的评测框架。

sents.en: It decomposes temporal consistency into local and global components, measured using six complementary metrics.
sents.zh: 它将时序一致性分解为局部和全局两个组成部分，并使用六项互补的指标进行度量。

sents.zh: 局部一致性捕捉短期时序连续性，并包含对不一致事件的显式检测与计数，而全局一致性则衡量长期的主体身份保持能力。

paragraphs.en: We design a controlled synthetic experiment that intentionally injects local and global inconsistencies. In this setting, evaluating only subjects visible in the initial frames cannot fully capture subject consistency throughout the video. Meanwhile, compared with holistic frame-level evaluation like VBench, our metrics show substantially greater sensitivity and clearly reflect changes in the prevalence of injected inconsistencies. We further validate DynSC-Eval across a diverse set of commercial and open-source models at 5s, commercial models at 15s, and streaming models at 60s. DynSC-Eval distinguishes models with similar VBench consistency scores and reveals complementary failure patterns in local continuity and global identity preservation, demonstrating its effectiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一个受控合成实验，刻意注入局部与全局不一致性。 在该设定下，仅评估初始帧中可见的主体无法充分捕捉整个视频中主体的一致性。 同时，与VBench这类整体帧级评估相比，我们的指标表现出显著更强的灵敏度，并能清晰反映所注入不一致性流行度的变化。 我们进一步在多样化的模型集合上验证了DynSC-Eval，包括5秒的商业与开源模型、15秒的商业模型以及60秒的流式模型。 DynSC-Eval能够区分VBench一致性得分相近的模型，并揭示局部连续性与全局身份保持方面互补的失效模式，证明了其有效性。

sents.zh: 我们进一步在多样化的模型集合上验证了DynSC-Eval，包括5秒的商业与开源模型、15秒的商业模型以及60秒的流式模型。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, we design rewards based on DynSC-Eval to guide model optimization and improve subject consistency. We adopt autonomous driving as a representative testbed, where high-speed motion with multiple objects tend to expose temporal inconsistencies, which is practically critical for this domain. We first fine-tune text-to-video (T2V) models Wan-2.1-1.3B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and SANA-2B ( Chen et al., 2025b ) on 100 hours of real-world videos to establish 5s baselines. We then design consistency rewards based on DynSC-Eval metrics and perform post-training with DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . On an independent held-out evaluation set of 100 videos, our approach yields average relative reductions of 13.82% and 5.66% across all six inconsistency metrics for Wan-2.1-1.3B and SANA-2B, respectively, while other capabilities, such as visual quality and motion dynamics, are preserved. Qualitative results also align with these numerical findings. We further apply the same optimization framework to the image-to-video (I2V) model ReSim ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and improve all consistency metrics of DynSC-Eval. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our consistency rewards across both T2V and I2V generation.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们基于 DynSC-Eval 设计奖励，以引导模型优化并提升主体一致性。 我们采用自动驾驶作为代表性测试平台，该领域中多物体的高速运动容易暴露时间不一致性，因此这一评估对该领域具有重要的实际意义。 我们首先在 100 小时真实世界视频上微调文本生成视频（T2V）模型 Wan-2.1-1.3B（Wang et al., 2025）和 SANA-2B（Chen et al., 2025b），以建立 5 秒基线。 随后，我们基于 DynSC-Eval 指标设计一致性奖励，并使用 DiffusionNFT（Zheng et al., 2025）进行后训练。 在包含 100 个视频的独立保留评估集上，我们的方法使 Wan-2.1-1.3B 和 SANA-2B 在全部六项不一致性指标上分别取得 13.82% 和 5.66% 的平均相对降幅，同时视觉质量和运动动态等其他能力得以保留。 定性结果也与这些数值发现相一致。 我们进一步将相同的优化框架应用于图像生成视频（I2V）模型 ReSim（Yang et al., 2025b），并改进了 DynSC-Eval 的所有一致性指标。 这些结果表明我们的一致性奖励在 T2V 和 I2V 两种生成任务中均具有有效性。

paragraphs.en: Building on the improvements achieved for 5s generation, we extend our study to longer temporal horizons. Through curriculum learning, we progressively adapt the model to 10s and then 30s generation using an additional 100 and 200 hours of OpenDV data, respectively. We then apply DiffusionNFT with our consistency reward to both models, improving DynSC at both durations while largely preserving other capabilities. Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 在5秒生成所取得的改进基础上，我们将研究扩展到更长的时间跨度。 通过课程学习，我们分别使用额外的100小时和200小时OpenDV数据，逐步使模型适应10秒和30秒的生成。 然后，我们将带有一致性奖励的DiffusionNFT应用于这两个模型，在两个时长上都提升了DynSC，同时基本保留了其他能力。 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: (i) We highlight the importance that subject consistency evaluation should account for dynamic subject sets as video generation extends to longer durations.
paragraphs.zh: (i) 我们强调，随着视频生成扩展到更长时长，主体一致性评估应考虑动态主体集合的重要性。

paragraphs.en: (ii) We introduce DynSC-Eval , an evaluation framework that combines dynamic subject tracking, event-level detection, and consistency decomposition. We validate its sensitivity through synthetic experiments and demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse models and video durations.

paragraphs.en: (iii) We design rewards based on DynSC-Eval and adopt autonomous driving as a testbed to post-train 5s models, achieving substantial subject consistency gains across both T2V and I2V models while largely preserving other capabilities, with qualitative results further supporting these improvements.

paragraphs.en: (iv) We then extend video generation from 5s to 30s via curriculum learning, demonstrating that our reward optimization also yields significant consistency gains in long-video generation.
paragraphs.zh: (iv) 随后，我们通过课程学习将视频生成时长从 5 秒扩展到 30 秒，证明我们的奖励优化方法在长视频生成中也能带来显著的一致性提升。

paragraphs.en: Temporal consistency is an important dimension of video generation evaluation. General benchmarks, including VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , VBench++ ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , and EvalCrafter ( Liu et al., 2023b ) , primarily assess temporal consistency through holistic frame-level comparisons. A complementary line uses human judgments and learned evaluators ( He et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Inbasekar et al., 2026 ) . LongAV-Compass ( Liu et al., 2026 ) extends evaluation to minute-level audio-visual generation using MLLM assessment and complementary perceptual metrics. These approaches provide broad perceptual and semantic coverage. However, such holistic evaluations struggle to localize inconsistencies in individual subjects and have limited sensitivity to discrete inconsistency events.
paragraphs.zh: 时间一致性是视频生成评估的一个重要维度。 通用基准，包括 VBench（Huang 等，2023）、VBench++（Huang 等，2024）和 EvalCrafter（Liu 等，2023b），主要通过整体帧级别的比较来评估时间一致性。 另一条互补的研究路线则使用人类判断和学习得到的评估器（He 等，2024；Han 等，2025；Li 等，2025；Inbasekar 等，2026）。 LongAV-Compass（Liu 等，2026）借助多模态大语言模型评估以及互补的感知指标，将评估扩展到分钟级的视听生成。 这些方法提供了广泛的感知和语义覆盖。 然而，这类整体性评估难以定位单个主体中的不一致之处，并且对离散的不一致事件敏感性有限。

paragraphs.en: Subject-level evaluations address more specific aspects of consistency. T2V-CompBench ( Sun et al., 2024 ) evaluates compositional generation via MLLM judges, subject detection, and tracking, targeting consistent attribute binding and object interactions. JoyAI-Echo ( Li et al., 2026 ) emphasizes character identity consistency across shots in long-form audio-visual generation. Recent works, including DrivingGen ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , MBench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and WBench ( Ying et al., 2026 ) , evaluate subject consistency using designated targets or first-frame-based protocols, yet comprehensive coverage of the evolving subject set, including subjects entering later as videos grow longer, remains insufficiently addressed. In contrast, DynSC-Eval explicitly evaluates dynamic subject sets, including all eligible subjects that first appear after the initial frame. It separately measures local disruptions and global drift and detects inconsistency events, providing a more comprehensive and accurate assessment of subject consistency throughout the video.
paragraphs.zh: 主体层面的评估涉及一致性的更具体方面。 T2V-CompBench（Sun et al., 2024）通过多模态大语言模型评判者、主体检测与跟踪来评估组合式生成，侧重于一致的属性绑定和物体交互。 JoyAI-Echo（Li et al., 2026）强调长时视听生成中跨镜头的角色身份一致性。 近期工作，包括 DrivingGen（Zhou et al., 2026）、MBench（Zhang et al., 2026）和 WBench（Ying et al., 2026），使用指定目标或基于首帧的协议来评估主体一致性，但对不断演变的主体集合的全面覆盖仍不够充分，包括随着视频变长而后续进入的主体。 相比之下，DynSC-Eval 显式评估动态主体集合，包括所有在初始帧之后首次出现的合格主体。 它分别度量局部扰动和全局漂移，并检测不一致事件，从而对整个视频中的主体一致性提供更全面、更准确的评估。

paragraphs.en: Policy optimization methods such as PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) and GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) provide foundations for learning from reward feedback. For diffusion models, DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) incorporates reward feedback into forward-process flow-matching updates by contrasting positive and negative generations. In video generation, InstructVideo ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) adapts image-based preference rewards through segmental sampling and temporal attenuation while Control-A-Video ( Chen et al., 2023 ) incorporates reward feedback into controllable generation. Some works explicitly design consistency signals to improve temporal consistency in video generation. Video Consistency Distance ( Aoshima et al., 2025 ) uses a frequency-domain discrepancy between generated frame features and a conditioning image for I2V fine-tuning. IPRO ( Shen et al., 2025 ) targets facial identity preservation using identity-based rewards. SHIFT ( Ye et al., 2026 ) introduces pixel-motion rewards for instantaneous and long-term motion consistency within a hybrid supervised and advantage-weighted fine-tuning framework. Our work adopts DiffusionNFT as the optimization framework and designs a dynamic subject consistency reward that combines local and global signals, substantially improving subject consistency in generated videos, with gains further validated on long videos.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 PPO（Schulman et al., 2017）和 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）等策略优化方法为从奖励反馈中学习提供了基础。 对于扩散模型，DiffusionNFT（Zheng et al., 2025）通过对比正例与负例生成，将奖励反馈融入前向过程的流匹配更新中。 在视频生成领域，InstructVideo（Yuan et al., 2023）通过分段采样和时间衰减将基于图像的偏好奖励适配过来，而 Control-A-Video（Chen et al., 2023）则将奖励反馈融入可控生成之中。 一些工作显式地设计一致性信号，以提升视频生成中的时间一致性。 视频一致性距离（Aoshima et al., 2025）利用生成帧特征与条件图像之间在频域上的差异，用于 I2V 微调。 IPRO（Shen et al., 2025）利用基于身份的奖励来实现人脸身份保持。 SHIFT（Ye et al., 2026）在一个混合监督与优势加权微调框架中引入了像素运动奖励，以实现瞬时与长期的运动一致性。 我们的工作采用 DiffusionNFT 作为优化框架，并设计了一种结合局部与全局信号的动态主体一致性奖励，显著提升了生成视频中的主体一致性，其增益还在长视频上得到进一步验证。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present our evaluation framework. Section 3.1 describes the evaluation pipeline and defines six metrics covering local and global consistency. Section 3.2 presents controlled synthetic experiments with deliberately injected inconsistency events, validating the effectiveness of our metrics. paragraphs.en: Local consistency measures both discrete inconsistency events and continuous short-term appearance variation . Inconsistency events can be grouped into three categories: (i) Sudden appearance : a trajectory begins away from the temporal and spatial boundaries of the video, while the corresponding region in the preceding frame contains no compatible object; (ii) Sudden disappearance : a trajectory terminates within the valid region, and no compatible object remains in the corresponding region of the subsequent frame; (iii) Severe appearance mutation : an existing object undergoes an abrupt deformation or identity change. The first two event types are identified from detected trajectory onsets and terminations, subject to the above spatial and temporal boundary and compatibility constraints. For the third type, a transition is classified as a severe appearance mutation if the appearance distance is larger than τ \tau , where τ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \tau\in(0,1) is a conservative threshold for capturing large and visually salient changes. In the following, we describe the three local consistency metrics and formal definitions are provided in the Appendix A.3.1

paragraphs.en: Spike Rate (SR): The fraction of valid trajectories containing at least one inconsistency event.
paragraphs.zh: Spike 率（SR）：包含至少一次不一致事件的有效轨迹所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: Events per 100 Track-seconds (ER): The number of inconsistency events per 100 seconds of valid trajectory duration, capturing repeated failures.
paragraphs.zh: 每100轨道秒事件数（ER）：每100秒有效轨迹时长内的不一致性事件数量，用于捕捉重复出现的失败。

paragraphs.en: Mean Adjacent Drift (MAD): The appearance distance between consecutive temporally smoothed observations, averaged within each valid trajectory and then across trajectories, capturing short-term variation even below the event threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 平均相邻漂移（MAD）：连续时间平滑后的观测结果之间的出现距离，先在每个有效轨迹内取平均值，再跨轨迹取平均，从而捕捉即使低于事件阈值的短期变化。

paragraphs.en: Together, these metrics characterize local consistency through failure prevalence, event frequency, and short-term appearance drift.
paragraphs.zh: 这些指标共同通过故障流行度、事件频率和短期外观漂移来刻画局部一致性。

paragraphs.en: Global consistency evaluates whether an object preserves its initially established identity throughout its trajectory. Since global consistency requires a sufficiently long temporal span to establish a reliable reference appearance, we only compute global consistency metrics for trajectories containing at least 16 frames. Trajectories shorter than 16 frames are evaluated only using the local consistency metrics. For each trajectory, we construct a robust identity reference by averaging and normalizing the embeddings of its first q q valid observations. An endpoint embedding is similarly obtained. paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 (left) illustrates our inconsistency injection scheme. Local inconsistency simulates sudden appearance or disappearance and a brief appearance mutation: the object’s contour becomes a five-pointed star for 8 frames at midlife before returning to its original shape. Global inconsistency simulates persistent shape drift: each object smoothly transitions to a target shape and retains it until leaving the scene. Each object undergoes one transition according to the fixed mapping circle → triangle \text{circle}\rightarrow\text{triangle} , triangle → square \text{triangle}\rightarrow\text{square} , square → pentagon \text{square}\rightarrow\text{pentagon} , and pentagon → circle \text{pentagon}\rightarrow\text{circle} . We interpolate radially between the source and target contours. The implementation details are provided in Appendix A.4 . Under this setting, restricting evaluation to subjects visible in the initial frames can miss many injected inconsistencies. Initial frames may contain no eligible subjects, or the initially visible subjects may remain consistent while inconsistencies occur among later arrivals, demonstrating its limitation. We next assess the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and compare it with holistic frame-level assessment.

paragraphs.en: We next design consistency rewards that directly guide model optimization. We adopt autonomous driving as a representative testbed because driving videos contain multiple persistent vehicles undergoing continuous motion and frequent interactions, which provides abundant object trajectories for exposing both abrupt local failures and accumulated global drift. We establish two baselines based on Wan-2.1-1.3B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and SANA-2B ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . We sample real-world videos from OpenDV and divide them into 5s clips, obtaining approximately 100 hours of data. Each clip is automatically captioned using Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) to construct text–video pairs. Both models are fine-tuned on the same dataset to obtain the baselines. Refer to Appendix B.1 for details.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们设计一致性奖励，直接引导模型优化。 我们选择自动驾驶作为代表性测试平台，因为驾驶视频包含多辆持续存在且 undergoing 连续运动与频繁交互的车辆，为暴露突发局部失败与累积全局漂移提供了丰富的物体轨迹。 我们基于 Wan-2.1-1.3B（Wang et al., 2025）和 SANA-2B（Chen et al., 2025b）建立了两个基线。 我们从 OpenDV 中采样真实世界视频，并将其切分为 5 秒的片段，获得约 100 小时的数据。 每个片段使用 Qwen3-VL-8B（Bai et al., 2025）自动生成字幕，以构建文本–视频对。 两个模型都在同一数据集上进行微调以得到基线。 详细内容参见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: We use Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) to construct 300 multi-vehicle prompts and independently train the 5s Wan-2.1-1.3B and SANA-2B baselines with DiffusionNFT for 75 steps. Given the stricter requirements for subject consistency in autonomous driving, we use a lower threshold of τ = 0.16 \tau=0.16 to increase sensitivity to severe appearance mutation detection. As shown in Table 3 , both models improve across all six DynSC-Eval metrics. For Wan-2.1-1.3B, post-training reduces SR, ER and MAD by 13.3%, 22.2%, 16.6% . Global consistency also improves, with ED, MRD, and WFD decreasing by 10.2%, 11.0% and 9.6% . SANA-2B exhibits consistent improvements: its three local metrics decrease by 5.11%, 5.99%, 6.65% while its three global metrics decrease by 6.08%, 5.96% and 4.19% . Meanwhile, VBench metrics indicate our method improves temporal consistency while preserving other capabilities. Qualitative results in Fig. 5 with additional examples on the project website , corroborate the quantitative findings, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method.

paragraphs.en: We next investigate whether our optimization framework can extend to I2V generation. We adopt ReSim ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , an open-source autonomous-driving model at 4.9s, and apply DiffusionNFT to train it with the same 300 prompts. As shown in Table 3 , our method improves all six DynSC-Eval metrics, with average reductions of 6.61% and 3.14% for local and global inconsistency metrics, respectively. These results extend our findings beyond T2V generation and support the applicability of the proposed feedback rewards across different generation paradigms.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来我们研究我们的优化框架能否扩展到 I2V 生成。 我们采用 ReSim（Yang et al., 2025b），一个 4.9s 的开源自动驾驶模型，并使用相同的 300 条提示词应用 DiffusionNFT 对其进行训练。 如表 3 所示，我们的方法改进了全部六项 DynSC-Eval 指标，局部与全局不一致性指标分别平均降低 6.61% 和 3.14%。 这些结果将我们的发现扩展到了 T2V 生成之外，并支持所提出的反馈奖励在不同生成范式中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: Long-video generation presents a greater challenge to temporal consistency, as object states must remain coherent over longer durations and errors can accumulate over time. Building on the consistency improvements achieved for 5s videos, we next investigate how to improve temporal consistency as generation scales to longer horizons. We adopt a curriculum learning strategy to progressively extend the driving model from 5s to 10s and then 30s. Specifically, we fine-tune the 5s Wan-2.1-1.3B on an additional 100 hours of 10s OpenDV clips, followed by 200 hours of 30s clips, with no overlap among the training subsets. Details are provided in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: We highlight the importance of evaluating subject consistency over dynamic subject sets in long video generation. Accordingly, we introduce DynSC-Eval , which tracks eligible subjects and measures local and global consistency, including inconsistency events detection. Synthetic experiments and evaluations across diverse models and durations validate its sensitivity and discriminative power, exposing limitations of existing methods. Using autonomous driving as a testbed, we show that rewards derived from DynSC-Eval improve subject consistency across T2V and I2V models, with gains extending to 10s and 30s generation while preserving other capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们强调了在长视频生成中评估动态主体集上主体一致性的重要性。 为此，我们提出了 DynSC-Eval，它追踪符合条件的主体并衡量局部与全局一致性，包括不一致事件检测。 合成实验以及在多种模型和时长上的评估验证了其敏感性与区分能力，并揭示了现有方法的局限性。 以自动驾驶作为测试平台，我们展示了由 DynSC-Eval 导出的奖励能够提升 T2V 与 I2V 模型的主体一致性，收益可延伸至 10 秒和 30 秒的生成，同时保持其他能力。

paragraphs.en: For a continuous single-shot video, temporal consistency requires more than visually smooth frame transitions. A generated subject should remain locally coherent from one moment to the next, while also preserving its identity and appearance over a much longer temporal horizon. Accordingly, we decompose temporal consistency into two dimensions: local consistency and global consistency .
paragraphs.zh: 对于连续的单次生成视频，时间一致性所要求的不仅仅是视觉上平滑的帧间过渡。 生成的主体应当从一刻到下一刻保持局部连贯，同时在更长的时间跨度上保持其身份与外观。 因此，我们将时间一致性分解为两个维度：局部一致性与全局一致性。

sents.en: For a continuous single-shot video, temporal consistency requires more than visually smooth frame transitions.

sents.en: A generated subject should remain locally coherent from one moment to the next, while also preserving its identity and appearance over a much longer temporal horizon.

sents.en: Accordingly, we decompose temporal consistency into two dimensions: local consistency and global consistency .
sents.zh: 因此，我们将时间一致性分解为两个维度：局部一致性与全局一致性。

paragraphs.en: Local consistency measures whether a subject’s state evolves continuously over short temporal intervals. For nearby observations along the same trajectory, changes caused by motion should occur smoothly rather than abruptly. Local inconsistency manifests as transient events, such as sudden appearance or disappearance and severe deformation, which should be explicitly detected and penalized. This dimension directly reflects the model’s ability to maintain short-term temporal continuity.
paragraphs.zh: 局部一致性衡量主体的状态是否在短时间间隔内连续演化。 对于同一轨迹上相邻的观测，由运动引起的变化应当平滑而非突然。 局部不一致表现为瞬态事件，例如突然出现或消失以及严重形变，这些应被显式检测并加以惩罚。 该维度直接反映模型维持短期时间连续性的能力。

paragraphs.en: Global consistency measures whether the generative model preserves a subject’s established state and identity throughout its complete trajectory. Despite substantial motion and viewpoint changes, later observations should remain compatible with the same underlying subject. This dimension reflects the model’s capacity for long-term memory.

paragraphs.en: Conventional approaches often collapse these behaviors into a single aggregate score, obscuring their distinct failure mechanisms and providing ambiguous supervision for model optimization. In contrast, a more effective approach is to evaluate local discontinuities and global trajectory drift separately and use the resulting subject-trajectory signals as complementary feedback for optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 传统方法往往将这些行为压缩为单一的综合分数，从而掩盖了它们各自不同的失败机制，也为模型优化提供了模糊的监督信号。 与之相比，更有效的做法是分别评估局部不连续性与全局轨迹漂移，并将由此得到的“主体—轨迹”信号作为互补反馈用于优化。

paragraphs.en: Track initialization and termination are intrinsically ambiguous because a subject may naturally enter or leave the camera view. Directly including these observations in feature-based computation may introduce noisy distances or false positive signals. Let s i s_{i} and e i e_{i} denote the first and last frame indices of trajectory 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} . We use a temporal margin of m = 4 m=4 frames. If s i > m s_{i}>m , we exclude the first m m observations of 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} from feature-based consistency computation. Similarly, if e i ≤ T − m e_{i}\leq T-m , we exclude its last m m observations. Although these boundary observations are omitted when computing appearance distances, their neighboring frames are retained for determining whether the trajectory constitutes an abnormal appearance or disappearance event.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹的初始化与终止本质上存在歧义，因为目标可能会自然地进入或离开相机视野。 直接将这些观测纳入基于特征的计算可能会引入含噪的距离或假阳性信号。 设 s i s_{i} 和 e i e_{i} 表示轨迹 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 的首帧和末帧索引。 我们使用的时间边距为 m = 4 m=4 帧。 若 s i > m s_{i}>m ，我们将 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 的前 m m 个观测从基于特征的一致性计算中排除。 类似地，若 e i ≤ T − m e_{i}\leq T-m ，我们排除其最后 m m 个观测。 尽管这些边界观测在计算外观距离时被省略，但它们的相邻帧会被保留，用于判断该轨迹是否构成异常的外观出现或消失事件。

paragraphs.en: We construct paired synthetic videos to examine how consistency metrics respond to controlled shape perturbations at different temporal scales. Each video contains 480 frames at 16 FPS, with a resolution of 832 × 480 832\times 480 . A total of 20 geometric objects are introduced sequentially along two predefined motion paths. Their initial shapes are sampled from circles, triangles, squares, and pentagons, with radius parameters ranging from 72 to 84 pixels. Each object has a scheduled lifetime of 10 seconds. This lifetime includes entering and leaving the image boundary; the interval during which its contour is visible can therefore be slightly shorter. In the following, object age t t denotes elapsed time since its scheduled birth, rather than since its first visible pixel. Object colors, motion trajectories, birth times, and radius parameters are shared across paired conditions.

paragraphs.en: We assign selected objects as evenly as possible to three types of local inconsistency: severe appearance mutations, sudden appearances, and sudden disappearances. Each selected object receives one perturbation. For appearance mutations, we replace the object’s current contour with a deeply concave five-pointed star at an age of approximately 5 seconds. The onset is rounded to the nearest native video frame, and the replacement lasts exactly 8 frames (0.5 seconds). The star has an inner-to-outer radius ratio of 0.1 and preserves the object’s center, outer radius parameter, and color. Afterward, the object resumes its unperturbed shape evolution. For abrupt appearances, we hide the object during its natural entry and reveal it at an age of 3 seconds. For abrupt disappearances, we remove the object at an age of 6.5 seconds for the remainder of its scheduled lifetime. Both events occur inside the image, with onsets mapped to the first native frame at or after the prescribed time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将选中的对象尽可能均匀地分配到三种局部不一致性类型：严重的外观突变、突然出现和突然消失。 每个被选中的对象接受一次扰动。 对于外观突变，我们在对象年龄约为 5 秒时，将其当前轮廓替换为一个深度凹陷的五角星。 起始时间被取整到最接近的原始视频帧，替换恰好持续 8 帧（0.5 秒）。 该五角星的内外半径比为 0.1，并保留对象的中心、外半径参数和颜色。 之后，对象恢复其未受扰动的形状演化。 对于突然出现，我们在对象的自然进入期间将其隐藏，并在其年龄为 3 秒时显示它。 对于突然消失，我们在对象年龄为 6.5 秒时将其移除，直至其预定生命周期的剩余部分。 两个事件都发生在图像内部，起始时间被映射到不早于规定时间的第一个原始帧。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune the pretrained Wan-2.1-1.3B and SANA-2B using the same dataset and training protocol. The dataset comprises 72,000 nominal five-second OpenDV clips, totaling approximately 100 hours. A fixed split with seed 314159 partitions the data at the parquet-file level into 68,400 training clips and 3,600 validation clips (95%/5%). Each input contains 77 frames at a resolution of 480 × 832 480\times 832 (height × \times width), corresponding to 20 latent temporal positions. We use precomputed video latents and update all transformer parameters with full bidirectional attention.

paragraphs.en: Both models are trained for one epoch (8,550 updates) on eight A100-GPUs, with one sample per GPU and no gradient accumulation, yielding an effective batch size of eight. The learning rate increases linearly over the first 428 updates and subsequently follows a cosine decay. To monitor training stability, we evaluate 128 fixed held-out clips at initialization and every 100 updates, using fixed noise samples and timesteps with seed 314159. We record the overall velocity MSE and its low-, mid-, and high-noise components. Fig. 9 and Fig. 10 show the training curves for Wan-2.1-1.3B and SANA-2B, respectively. Both models exhibit stable training and reduced validation loss. However, validation velocity MSE alone does not reliably indicate generated video quality: despite these improvements in both models, our final consistency evaluation and visual inspection favor the fine-tuned Wan-2.1-1.3B model. Given its stronger empirical performance and our limited computational budget, we use Wan-2.1-1.3B exclusively for subsequent fine-tuning experiments at 10s and 30s.
paragraphs.zh: 两个模型均在八块 A100-GPU 上以一个 epoch（8,550 次更新）进行训练，每个 GPU 一个样本且无梯度累积，因此有效批大小为八。 学习率在前 428 次更新中线性上升，随后按余弦衰减。 为了监控训练稳定性，我们在初始化时以及每 100 次更新后，使用种子 314159 固定的噪声样本和时间步，对 128 个固定的留出片段进行评估。 我们记录整体速度 MSE 及其低噪声、中噪声和高噪声分量。 图 9 和图 10 分别展示了 Wan-2.1-1.3B 和 SANA-2B 的训练曲线。 两个模型均表现出稳定的训练过程和不断下降的验证损失。 然而，仅凭验证速度 MSE 并不能可靠地反映生成视频的质量：尽管两个模型都有上述改进，我们最终的一致性评估和目视检查仍更青睐微调后的 Wan-2.1-1.3B 模型。 鉴于其更强的实证表现以及我们有限的计算预算，后续在 10 秒和 30 秒下的微调实验均仅使用 Wan-2.1-1.3B。

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning on 10s and 30s clips follows the same optimization setup as the 5s stage, with the corresponding hyperparameters summarized in Tab. 6 . We use dense spatiotemporal attention for both durations to enable information exchange across the entire video sequence. The 10s experiments are conducted on two nodes with eight A100 GPUs each, while the 30s experiments use four such nodes. As shown in Fig. 11 , the validation loss decreases steadily for both durations and gradually stabilizes toward the end of training, indicating stable optimization when extending the model from 5s to longer video generation.

paragraphs.en: We maintain three policies during training. The current policy contains the trainable LoRA parameters and is optimized using AdamW. The old policy generates training rollouts and is updated from the current policy using an exponential moving average after each optimizer step. The reference policy is the frozen domain-adapted model obtained by disabling the LoRA adapters. The old policy stabilizes rollout generation, while the reference policy constrains the optimized model from deviating excessively from its original generation behavior. For each prompt, the old policy generates a group of G = 8 G=8 videos. Their rewards are standardized within the group, enabling the current policy to learn from relative consistency differences under the same conditioning prompt. In the 5s setting, we accumulate 4 prompt groups before each optimizer update, resulting in 32 rollouts per update. Each rollout uses 10 diffusion sampling steps. For efficient optimization, we stratify the rollout trajectory and sample 4 diffusion timesteps for computing the training objective.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在训练过程中维护三个策略。 当前策略包含可训练的 LoRA 参数，并使用 AdamW 进行优化。 旧策略用于生成训练 rollout，并在每次优化器更新后通过指数移动平均从当前策略更新而来。 参考策略是通过禁用 LoRA 适配器得到的冻结领域自适应模型。 旧策略用于稳定 rollout 生成，而参考策略则约束优化后的模型，防止其过度偏离原有的生成行为。 对于每个提示词，旧策略生成一组 G = 8 个视频。 这些奖励在组内进行标准化，使当前策略能够在相同的条件提示词下从相对一致性差异中学习。 在 5s 设置中，我们在每次优化器更新前累积 4 个提示词组，即每次更新产生 32 个 rollout。 每个 rollout 使用 10 个扩散采样步。 为了实现高效优化，我们对 rollout 轨迹进行分层，并采样 4 个扩散时间步用于计算训练目标。

paragraphs.en: Optimizing consistency alone may encourage degenerate solutions, such as motion suppression or excessive deviation from the pretrained model. We therefore regularize the current policy against a frozen reference policy using spatial and temporal constraints. Table 7 compares consistency optimization with and without regularization and Fig. 12 shows the validation curves of all six metrics. Even without regularization, optimizing the DynSC-Eval reward improves all six consistency metrics over the 5s baseline. Adding regularization further improves both local and global metrics, decreasing SR from 0.2397 0.2397 to 0.2220 0.2220 and ER from 7.853 7.853 to 7.139 7.139 , while also improving MAD, ED, MRD, and WFD. Importantly, these gains do not come from suppressing motion: the VBench motion score remains nearly unchanged ( 98.36 98.36 vs. 98.49 98.49 ), while dynamic degree increases from 91.00 91.00 to 92.00 92.00 . This indicates that regularization stabilizes reward optimization and yields additional consistency improvements without sacrificing video dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 仅优化一致性可能会促使模型产生退化的解，例如抑制运动或过度偏离预训练模型。 因此，我们使用空间和时间约束，将当前策略相对于冻结的参考策略进行正则化。 表7比较了带正则化与不带正则化的一致性优化，图12展示了全部六项指标的验证曲线。 即使不使用正则化，优化 DynSC-Eval 奖励也能在 5s 基线之上改进全部六项一致性指标。 加入正则化进一步改进了局部和全局指标，将 SR 从 0.2397 0.2397 降至 0.2220 0.2220，将 ER 从 7.853 7.853 降至 7.139 7.139，同时还改进了 MAD、ED、MRD 和 WFD。 重要的是，这些提升并非来自抑制运动：VBench 运动分数几乎保持不变（98.36 98.36 对比 98.49 98.49），而动态程度则从 91.00 91.00 提升到 92.00 92.00。 这表明正则化能够稳定奖励优化，并在不牺牲视频动态性的前提下带来额外的一致性改进。
